notes.label: Runs
notes.body: You set it up from the portal today at 3:24 PM. It has not run yet, so the first sweep is the next one due.

notes.label: Takes
notes.body: Open issues in metalcraftai/ufo carrying no comment from me: 177 of the 180 open right now, so the first sweep starts on a long queue and will not clear it in one fire.

notes.label: Writes
notes.body: One comment per issue: what it is really asking for, who should own it, the plan I would follow, and anything I could not settle rather than a guess.

notes.label: Skips
notes.body: Any issue already carrying a comment from me. Three do, #2040, #1124 and #1044, from earlier review work, so triage leaves those alone until you name one.

notes.label: Would do
notes.body: On each sweep, take the issues carrying ufo:implement that have no pull request, write the change for each, and open a pull request naming the issue.

notes.label: To arm it
notes.body: Ask me for it and say how often to sweep. I set the sweep up, then do the work once for the issue in front of you, so the ask is answered now and not at the next fire.

notes.label: Approval
notes.body: The ufo:implement label does not exist in metalcraftai/ufo yet, so no issue is approved. Approve one in chat and I put the label on it and tell you I did.

notes.label: Off means off
notes.body: Until you arm it I write no code and open no pull request, not even for an issue whose plan is settled.
